# remove-field

Remove a field from a Main form. Without --section, removes all occurrences of the field; with --section, removes only from the specified section.

## Usage

```
ppds forms remove-field [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--entity` |  | `string` |  | Entity logical name |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--field` |  | `string` |  | Field logical name to remove |
| `--form` |  | `string` |  | Name or ID of the form |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--publish` |  | `bool` |  | Publish customizations after writing |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--section` |  | `string` |  | Label or name of the section to remove the field from. If omitted, all occurrences of the field are removed from the form. |
| `--solution` |  | `string` |  | Solution unique name to associate the change with |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
